basis_label: Dimensions and anatomical or structural basis
author: Universe Scales
note: Original adult saltwater crocodile (Crocodylus porosus) anatomical illustration uniformly calibrated to Lolong’s Guinness-verified 6.17 m nose-to-tail length. The Australian Museum supplies the broad snout, heavy adult build, dorsal eyes/nostrils, osteoderms, muscular tail and cream-colored belly. Head, girth, limbs, scute pattern/count, tail profile, colors and pose are authored generic adult geometry, not measurements or a reconstruction of Lolong himself. Mouth is almost closed; visible teeth are schematic and not a dental inventory. This is not a scan, juvenile, freshwater crocodile, alligator or game asset.

processing.details: All other shapes, placements, surface pattern and colors are authored illustration controls, not measured data.
